prompts.title: FIFA Mid-Air Connection
prompts.prompt:
Create a dynamic, ultra-realistic sports action photograph of an elite football player wearing the Brazil national team kit, captured at the precise moment of striking a football during a professional match. Full-body vertical composition, low-angle perspective, emphasizing athletic power, speed, and explosive movement. The player is positioned centrally in the frame, wearing Brazil’s iconic bright yellow jersey with green trim, green shorts, white knee-high socks with green and yellow accents, and blue football boots. His support leg is firmly planted on the turf while the kicking leg swings through with tremendous force, moments after contact with the ball. His arms are naturally extended for balance, highlighting muscular definition, tension, and athletic form.
The football is shown in motion immediately after impact, traveling away from the player. Dirt, grass, turf fragments, and tiny debris erupt from the ground around the planted foot and striking zone, creating a dramatic sense of energy and realism. Subtle motion blur is applied to the kicking leg and ball to enhance speed, while the player’s face remains razor-sharp, displaying intense concentration and determination. His eyes are locked on the ball, and his windswept hair adds to the dynamic movement of the scene.
Background: A packed football stadium filled with passionate supporters dressed in Brazil’s national colors. Brazilian flags are visible throughout the crowd. The spectators, banners, and stadium architecture are softly blurred through a shallow depth of field, creating strong subject separation while maintaining the atmosphere of a major international football match.
Lighting: Dramatic golden-hour sunlight streams from the upper-left corner of the frame, producing warm cinematic backlighting and a radiant glow across the scene. Strong rim lighting outlines the player’s hair, shoulders, arms, and jersey edges. Floating dust particles, illuminated grass fragments, and tiny airborne debris catch the sunlight, creating sparkling highlights throughout the image. Rich golden tones, realistic shadows, vibrant color contrast, and natural lens flare enhance the cinematic atmosphere.
Style: Hyper-realistic sports photography, FIFA World Cup atmosphere, cinematic action shot, professional sports advertising campaign, ultra-detailed textures, realistic fabric folds, visible jersey stitching, photorealistic skin detail, high dynamic range, sharp focus on the athlete, shallow depth of field, premium editorial sports aesthetic, dramatic and inspiring mood, 8K resolution, masterpiece quality.
Camera & Composition: Full-body vertical framing, low-angle field-level viewpoint, telephoto sports lens, fast shutter speed, professional sports photography, cinematic depth, realistic perspective, highly detailed grass texture, immersive stadium environment.
Aspect Ratio: 4:5.

prompts.title: Retro Green Tracksuit Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face matching and identity reference.
Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic 8K fashion editorial portrait of a confident man seated backwards on a vintage dark walnut wooden chair in a modern studio setting. The composition is a full-body vertical portrait (4:5 aspect ratio), with the subject perfectly centered. The chair is positioned centrally, acting as both a visual anchor and a framing element.
Pose & Expression:
The subject sits facing the backrest of the chair, resting both forearms casually across the top rail. One hand hangs naturally downward while the other gently overlaps the opposite arm. His posture is relaxed yet commanding, with slightly lowered shoulders and a subtle forward lean. He maintains direct eye contact with the camera. His expression is neutral and composed, with a slight hint of attitude and understated confidence.
Outfit & Styling:
The subject wears a premium emerald-green retro-inspired track jacket featuring white athletic stripe detailing along the sleeves, layered over a clean white hooded sweatshirt. The hoodie hood rests naturally around the neck and shoulders, adding visual depth and casual streetwear sophistication. He pairs the upper garments with oversized white parachute-style trousers featuring voluminous fabric folds and relaxed draping. On his feet are white-and-green leather low-top sneakers that coordinate harmoniously with the jacket. Background & Environment:
The setting features a seamless deep-emerald green studio backdrop extending smoothly from wall to floor, creating an infinity-wall effect. The highly reflective surface produces subtle reflections beneath the subject and chair. The environment is clean, minimal, and distraction-free, emphasizing the subject as the focal point.
Lighting:
Professional studio lighting with a large diffused key light positioned slightly camera-left creates soft, flattering illumination across the face and outfit.  A secondary fill light softens shadows while maintaining dimensionality. Subtle rim lighting separates the subject from the background, enhancing depth. The overall lighting is cinematic, soft, high-end, and editorial, with balanced contrast and smooth tonal transitions.
Camera Angle & Composition:
Eye-level camera angle positioned directly in front of the subject. Symmetrical framing with perfect central alignment. Premium fashion-editorial look. Full-body composition with no cropping of shoes, chair, or head. Balanced negative space surrounds the subject, enhancing the luxury magazine-cover aesthetic.
Technical Details:
Ultra-realistic 8K photography, DSLR-level clarity, 85mm lens, f/2.0, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the face and hands, realistic skin and fabric textures, natural color grading, HDR, cinematic contrast, subtle floor reflections, luxury editorial fashion aesthetic, studio-quality retouching, ultra-detailed, professional commercial campaign quality.
